reference_population: All six already announced Brazil fixtures; independent prospective sequence experiment at one fresh common cutoff. Existing first issues remain separate.
baseline: Active Current score matrix projected to common paired 1X2 and Asian total at market weight 1. Europe development uses date-separated archived goals-only proxy and Bet365 close.
sequence: Last five completed domestic league matches strictly before the fixture day; same per-step goals for, against, home indicator and validity masks. Same history and baseline expected goals for both learners.
fitting: Europe 2024/25 fixed development training, ensuing 2025/26 season evaluation; fixed recipe refit eligible completed rows before the future forecasts. No tuning on the six games. Fixed Poisson offset and bounded log-rate shift (+/-0.35), ridge 2. LSTM one 6-unit layer / 60 epochs, Adam .012, decay .01; LightGBM 40 trees, rate .05, 7 leaves, min 48, lambda 12. Seed 20261118.
metrics: unique MAP exact score as primary
strict full win at same actual Asian line, push excluded
paired gained and lost, coverage and probability quality
quality: First seen vs source timestamp stored separately. Newly obtained supplemental xG and lineup data are tracked independently of fixed matched-input experiment.
